description: Source code implementing the Bbr2StartupMode class for TCP congestion control in QUIC, including methods for managing startup phase behavior, congestion event handling, and debug state export.

classes.name: Bbr2StartupMode
classes.description: Implements the startup phase of the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm, managing bandwidth estimation, pacing, and transition conditions.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Bbr2StartupMode
methods.description: Constructor initializing startup mode, incrementing slowstart count, starting slowstart duration, and setting initial pacing and cwnd gains.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Enter
methods.description: Method should not be called; logs a bug if invoked.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Leave
methods.description: Stops slowstart duration timer and clears bandwidth lower bound.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events during startup, checks for bandwidth growth, loss conditions, and adjusts pacing gain accordingly.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::CheckExcessiveLosses
methods.description: Checks for excessive packet loss to exit startup phase.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports internal debug state for diagnostics.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs debug state information to an ostream.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Params
methods.description: Returns current parameters for startup mode.
